claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Arago, Gadsden, Havre via Falmouth, Aug 2,
with mdse and passengers, to New York and Havre Steam-
ship Co. Aug 3, lat 49 20, lon 10 10, exchanged signals with
bark Emma F Herriman, from Richibucto for Newport;
8th, lat 48 43, lon 20 41, exchanged signals with ship Mer-
rington, of Liverpool, bound W; 13th, lat 42 14, lon 62 02,
passed ship Metropolis, of St John, NB.
